title: Every Job, Every Player
format: 8v8 game, roles swap every few minutes
intro_vo: Every job, every player. In this game, players swap positions, so everyone learns every job in our shape.

steps.say: 8v8 shape: back three, wing backs, a middle and a striker.
steps.vo: Here is our eight a side shape. Three at the back, two wing backs, one in the middle, and a striker.

steps.say: Whistle! Rotate: 4 goes to midfield, 8 to the back.
steps.vo: Whistle! Time to rotate. Four moves into midfield, and eight drops into the back three.

steps.say: Wing backs swap with a centre back.
steps.vo: Now three swaps with five, so the wing back learns to defend, and the defender learns to get forward.

steps.say: New roles, same shape. Play on.
steps.vo: New jobs, same shape. Now we play, and everyone understands the whole team.
Five, now a wing back, crosses, and nine scores.

setup: 8v8, our shape is 3-2-1-1 plus keeper (a mini 3-5-2).
rules: Coach whistles every few minutes: players rotate positions.
points: Learn the job of the position you are in.
Talk to the teammate you swap with.
parents: Watch your child play in different positions. That is the plan: everyone learns every job in the team.
